edges.reason: unlock() authorizes solely on _previousOwner == msg.sender, so caller identity controls the ownership restore path.
unlock() gating depends on block.timestamp > _lockTime, a miner influenceable dependency on an ownership changing function.
lock() computes _lockTime = block.timestamp + time, tying the ownership lock window to the block timestamp.
_transfer computes the anti-bot window and launch time from block.timestamp, altering bot flagging based on timestamp.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router swap deadline.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the router liquidity deadline.
transfer() forwards _msgSender() as the from address into _transfer.
lock() writes the caller supplied duration into _lockTime, the value later used to gate unlock().
unlock() reassigns the _owner slot to the previous owner based only on the caller check.
setBotFees multiplies stored fees by _botIncreaseFee without any cap, amplifying fee arithmetic.
setBotFees overwrites _taxFee with _previousTaxFee * _botIncreaseFee.
takeDev derives its deduction from _devFee via division and multiplication.
takeMarketing derives its deduction from _marketingFee via division and multiplication.
setDevFee writes the caller supplied value into _devFee used in later fee math.
setDevFee reads _taxFee to recompute totalFeesTax and enforce the 20% cap.
setTaxFeePercent writes _taxFee which feeds all fee computations.
setMarketingFee writes _marketingFee used in takeMarketing and swap allocation.
setLiquidityFeePercent writes _liquidityFee used in liquidity fee calculations.
setMaxTransferAmountRate writes the anti-whale rate used by maxTransferAmount().
setNumTokensSellToAddToLiquidity writes the swap trigger threshold.
setMarketingWallet updates the address later used as an ETH call target.
setdevWallet updates the address later used as an ETH call target.
setBotFeeMultiplicator writes the multiplier applied in setBotFees.
setAntiBotSystemEnable toggles the anti-bot system flag.
excludeAntibot clears the bot flag for the supplied account.
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled toggles the automatic swap behavior.
setBotSettingTime writes timeAntiBot = 60 * _val used by the anti-bot window.
_transfer sets launchAddLiquidity when the recipient is the Uniswap pair.
_transfer writes launchTime from block.timestamp on first pair transfer.
_transfer flags _isBot[to] during the anti-bot window.
_transfer sets and clears the inSwapAndLiquify guard around the swap block.
_transfer conditionally calls swapAndSendMarketing when the threshold is exceeded.
_transfer conditionally calls swapAndSendDev when the threshold is exceeded.
_transfer invokes swapAndLiquify for the liquidity portion of the contract balance.
_transfer finally delegates the accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard for the non excluded cases.
_tokenTransfer branches on _isBot for sender and recipient to apply bot fees.
_tokenTransfer branches on _isExcludedFromFee to remove or restore fees.
_transferStandard mutates _rOwned balances for sender and recipient.
_transferStandard calls takeDev to deduct the dev fee.
_transferStandard calls takeMarketing to deduct the marketing fee.
swapAndSendMarketing performs an all-gas low-level ETH call to marketingWallet before the transfer flow completes.
swapAndSendDev performs an all-gas low-level ETH call to devWallet inside the transfer flow.
swapAndLiquify swaps half of the tokens for ETH through swapTokensForEth.
swapAndLiquify adds the remaining tokens and received ETH as liquidity.
swapTokensForEth invokes the router fee-on-transfer swap with a zero minimum output.
addLiquidity invokes router addLiquidityETH with zero slippage bounds.
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router to build the swap path and approve.
The constructor hands ownership to an arbitrary constructor argument via transferOwnership.
The constructor calls the factory createPair to set up the Uniswap pair.
The constructor stores the Uniswap V2 router address in state.
The constructor stores the created pair address in uniswapV2Pair.
The pair address returned by createPair is written into uniswapV2Pair.
The external ETH call to marketingWallet can reenter _transfer while the swap flow state is only partially updated.
The external ETH call to devWallet can reenter _transfer before accounting finalizes.
The router swap callbacks transfer tokens and ETH, allowing reentry into _transfer during swap and liquify.
Constructor argument _newOwner flows into the initial ownership assignment.
lock() duration parameter feeds the _lockTime computation.
transferOwnership parameter is written into the owner slot.
transfer recipient parameter flows into _transfer.
setMarketingWallet parameter is assigned to marketingWallet.
setdevWallet parameter is assigned to devWallet.
setMaxTransferAmountRate parameter is assigned to maxTransferAmountRate.
setNumTokensSellToAddToLiquidity parameter is scaled and stored.
from parameter drives the sender side of the transfer accounting.
to parameter drives the recipient side and the pair comparison.
amount parameter drives fee and anti-whale computations.
tokens parameter determines how much is swapped and sent to marketingWallet.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped through the router.
ethAmount parameter is forwarded as msg.value to addLiquidityETH.
setBotFeeMultiplicator parameter is assigned to _botIncreaseFee.
excludeAntibot account parameter indexes the _isBot mapping.
excludeFromFee account parameter indexes _isExcludedFromFee.
setExcludedFromAntiWhale account parameter indexes the anti-whale exclusion mapping.
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled boolean parameter is stored in state.
setAntiBotSystemEnable boolean parameter is stored in antibotSystemEnable.
setDevFee parameter is capped and written to _devFee.
setTaxFeePercent parameter is capped and written to _taxFee.
setMarketingFee parameter is capped and written to _marketingFee.
setLiquidityFeePercent parameter is capped and written to _liquidityFee.
setBotSettingTime parameter sets the anti-bot detection window.

Threshold argument only written to numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity.

Recipient argument only used inside _transfer accounting.
Amount argument only used inside _transfer fee and anti-whale math.
Token amount only consumed by the marketing swap and send routine.
Token amount only approved and swapped in the router call.
ETH amount only forwarded as msg.value to the router liquidity call.
Multiplier argument only written to _botIncreaseFee.
Account argument only indexes the _isBot mapping.
Account argument only indexes _isExcludedFromFee.
Account argument only indexes the anti-whale exclusion mapping.
Toggle argument only written to swapAndLiquifyEnabled.
Toggle argument only written to antibotSystemEnable.
Fee argument only written to _devFee after the cap check.
Fee argument only written to _taxFee after the cap check.
Fee argument only written to _marketingFee after the cap check.
Fee argument only written to _liquidityFee after the cap check.
